prompt: Which of the following are considered in the US to be non-alcoholic according to this article https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9506306/ but, according to the UK government, would not be defined as being alcohol-free: Kopparberg Strawberry & Lime Alcohol Free, Sheppy's Low Alcohol Classic Cider, Gordon's Pink Gin & Tonic Can, Jack Daniel's Whiskey & Coca-Cola, Old Mout Berries & Cherries 0%ABV, Thatchers Zero English Cider, and Adnams Wild Wave Non-Alcoholic 0.5% Cider?
instruction: Which of the following are considered in the US to be non-alcoholic according to this article https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC9506306/ but, according to the UK government, would not be defined as being alcohol-free: Kopparberg Strawberry & Lime Alcohol Free, Sheppy's Low Alcohol Classic Cider, Gordon's Pink Gin & Tonic Can, Jack Daniel's Whiskey & Coca-Cola, Old Mout Berries & Cherries 0%ABV, Thatchers Zero English Cider, and Adnams Wild Wave Non-Alcoholic 0.5% Cider?
answer:
Based on the article and my research on each product's ABV:

**US definition (from article)**: Non-alcoholic = ≤0.5% ABV  
**UK definition (from article)**: Alcohol-free = ≤0.05% ABV

| Product | ABV | US "Non-alcoholic"? | UK "Alcohol-free"? |
|---------|-----|---------------------|-------------------|
| Kopparberg Strawberry & Lime Alcohol Free | 0.05% | Yes | **Yes** (at the limit) |
| **Sheppy's Low Alcohol Classic Cider** | **0.5%** | **Yes** | **No** |
| Gordon's Pink Gin & Tonic Can | 5–7% | No | No |
| Jack Daniel's Whiskey & Coca-Cola | 5–7% | No | No |
| Old Mout Berries & Cherries 0% ABV | 0.0% | Yes | Yes |
| **Thatchers Zero English Cider** | **0.3%** | **Yes** | **No** |
| **Adnams Wild Wave Non-Alcoholic 0.5% Cider** | **0.5%** | **Yes** | **No** |

**Three products** meet the criteria (considered non-alcoholic in the US but NOT alcohol-free in the UK):

1. **Sheppy's Low Alcohol Classic Cider** (0.5% ABV)
2. **Thatchers Zero English Cider** (0.3% ABV)
3. **Adnams Wild Wave Non-Alcoholic 0.5% Cider** (0.5% ABV)
expected_answer: Sheppy's Low Alcohol Classic Cider, Thatchers Zero English Cider, Adnams Wild Wave Non-Alcoholic 0.5% Cider
